bio.text: Beau Bayh, a Democrat, won his party's nomination for Indiana Secretary of State at the Indiana Democratic convention in June 2026.
He is a U.S. Marine Corps captain and the son of former Gov. and Sen. Evan Bayh and grandson of former Sen. Birch Bayh.

He attended Harvard University for both his undergraduate and law degrees and, until August 2025, was a judicial law clerk in Bloomington for Judge David F. Hamilton of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit.
